projects.title: debian tools
description: A toolkit that simplifies first setup through easy-to-use scripts for Debian-based systems.
- Quickly install popular software packages without remembering complex commands
- Automate routine system administration tasks
- Save time during system setup and maintenance
## Features
The toolkit offers scripts for:
- Browser installations (Brave, LibreWolf, Waterfox)
- VPN setups (Mullvad, ProtonVPN, IVPN)
- Development environments (Qt/QML/C++)
- System configurations (systemd-resolved, GRUB)
- Virtualization tools (QEMU/KVM, Waydroid)
- Android tools (Custom ROM installation, WiFi network backup)
highlights: Consolidated multi-step installations into single scripts
Implemented consistent error handling and user feedback
Added uninstallation options for all components
projects.impact: Reduced system setup time and eliminated repetitive googling for common tasks
